newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kloeckner broke even in first four months.
newsitem.headline: Kloeckner broke even in first four months.

text.p: German engineering group Kloeckner Werke AG said Monday it broke even in the first four months of the business year 1996/97, compared with a loss of 16 million marks ($9.5 million) in the same period a year ago.
Sales in the period rose slightly to 1.3 billion marks ($773 million). New orders for the first four months also increased slightly to 1.4 billion marks ($833 million).
Kloeckner also said it expected operating profit for the full year to at least remain unchanged from the 49.3 million marks ($29 million) it earned last year.
